projects.name: agent-platform
projects.purpose: Central Python-first platform project for building, configuring, evaluating, and improving agents.
projects.scope: Reusable platform models, agent specs, evaluation helpers, planning helpers, open-source evaluation, and platform docs.
boundary_notes: Platform-wide reusable capabilities can live here when they are part of the central agent platform.
Domain-specific experiments should become separate root projects instead of being added to agent-platform by default.

projects.name: presentation-agent
projects.purpose: Presentation-focused agent project for collecting presentation design references, PPT/HTML sources, reusable assets, and script-flow evidence.
projects.scope: Presentation reference catalogs, project-specific presentation research, PPTX-to-HTML conversion helpers, presentation asset storage policy, and future presentation script/flow agents.
boundary_notes: Keep presentation-specific data, conversions, and generated artifacts inside presentation-agent/.
Store raw PPT/PPTX/assets only after project-local license review.
Reusable presentation reference curation behavior is tracked as a skill under _skills/.
